description: The migrated gated population (alpha-engine-config#6137): each item still carries the gate:* label its status was projected with, and every disposition is derived from declared dependencies evaluated against the observed world instead. p1's gate has cleared and it auto-merges without anyone editing the label; p2's has not and it blocks on the S3 key the gate actually named, not on the label that hid it; d1 is a draft whose gate cleared, so the loop advances it rather than resting on it. All three are one stage — in_flight — differing only in the condition of their change.
